title: Compressibility
summary: COMPRESSIBILITY, noun The quality of being compressible, or yielding to pressure; the quality of being capable of compression into a smaller space or compass; as the compressibility of elastic fluids,

inlines.v: COMPRESSIBILITY, noun The quality of being compressible, or yielding to pressure; the quality of being capable of compression into a smaller space or compass; as the compressibility of elastic fluids, or of any soft substance.
